name: step to the zero of the chord across the bracket, keeping the sign change
mechanism: draw the straight line between the two bracket endpoints and take its zero as the new point; replace whichever endpoint has the same sign, so the bracket is never lost; a stale endpoint is handled by halving its weight (the Illinois modification)

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'False position method' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Root finding: and Illinois method: 2-point, bracketing

fails_when: one endpoint can stick for many steps without the weighting fix
